title: Idempotency in 60 seconds
caption: Idempotency in 60 seconds: why pressing pay twice should not charge you twice.

scenes.say: You tap pay. The connection drops. Did it go through? You tap again. Now were you charged twice?
Idempotent means doing it twice has the same effect as doing it once.

items.title: Repeatable
items.say: Reading, setting a value, deleting: fine to repeat.

items.title: Not repeatable
items.say: Adding, charging, sending: not fine to repeat.

scenes.code:
POST /payments
Idempotency-Key: 5f1c-9a2e

→ seen this key before?
  return the first result
scenes.say: The fix is a key. The client sends a unique key with the request, and the server remembers it. A retry gets the first result back.

scenes.text:
Retry all you like.
*It happens once.*
scenes.say: That's idempotency. Retry all you like, it happens once.
